owner_direction: Check online practice and proceed with one approach; evaluate plywood cleats. This selects a development approach, not current geometry or physical work.
approach: Two adjacent, independently checked plywood leaves per cleat, retaining the four existing hole lines and Y/Z outline. No field glue or composite-section credit.
proposed_material: APA Rated Sturd-I-Floor 48 oc plywood, at least five plies; Group 1 for the directional bearing references. Proposed procurement specification; actual stamp, thickness and condition unobserved.
thickness_scope: 27 mm is a declared sizing assumption and minimum proposed actual thickness, not a cited PS 1 manufacturing tolerance or an observed measurement.
existing_axes: 100 frame bolts and 66 Hillman axes retained. Eight cleat stack grips change; their hardware and access require rechecking before a model revision.
strength_axis: Y, across the original solid cleat grain; both factory plywood leaves have the same orientation.

sources.role: Primary APA specification, Tables 5/9/13 and section 4.5.5; printed pages 22,24-27,32.
APA-authored original test report, p.3 Table 3. Different stacks and placements; not a candidate joint rating.
AWC Appendix A.3 supports larger-dowel plywood route. Use newer APA directional values in this proposal.
Current geometry identity; no response transfer.

design_factors.service: Dry use, panel moisture below 16%; proposed condition, not observation.
design_factors.Cs: PDS 4.5.5 using cut height perpendicular to Y stress; no impact increase or Structural I multiplier.

bolt_bearing_reference_psi.source: APA D510F Table 5, Group 1, 1/4 < D <= 1/2 in.; these are Fe inputs, not bolt capacities.

sharing_hypothesis: For preliminary sizing only, assign each leaf an equal complete saved-cut wrench at the original cut origin, then transport it to that leaf center. This recovers all six resultants but is not a compatible sharing proof or current-frame demand bound.
gross_interaction_hypothesis: max(membrane stress/Ft,-membrane stress/Fc) + abs(flat-bending component)/(FbS*Cs*cut height) + abs(in-plane shear)/Fv + abs(rolling shear)/Fs <=1. Conservative component combination for sizing; not an APA published whole-joint fracture equation.
remaining_gates: Individual leaf and joint load sharing, including axial captures/contact return
Actual near-end/mitered bolt-group geometry and local failure modes
Each changed stack, metal, washer and access
Revised-frame actions or justified conservative load coverage
